build_transformer_model: build a Transformer encoder-decoder model with configurable d_model, nhead, and layer count
create_transformer_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder that stacks cloned encoder layers with optional layer normalization
create_transformer_decoder: create a TransformerDecoder that returns intermediate outputs from all decoding layers
run_transformer_forward: run the Transformer forward pass with source, mask, query embed, and positional embed
review_transformer_encoder_layer: review the TransformerEncoderLayer self-attention and feedforward sub-layers with pre/post normalization
